Description: Two tiny rolled silver amulets found in a burial cave overlooking the Hinnom Valley, unrolled with great difficulty by conservators. They bear a Hebrew inscription closely matching the priestly blessing of Numbers 6.
BiblicalSignificance: These are the oldest surviving texts from the Hebrew Bible, dating to before Jerusalem fell to Babylon. That a family treasured 'The LORD bless you and keep you' on silver centuries before Christ is a tender, hope-anchored witness that God's blessing was already on His people's lips and hearts.
